catalog.title: San Francisco city events — official-source catalog
catalog.coverage: Publicly advertised events and recurring public programs located within the City and County of San Francisco. This is a dated, reproducible catalog; it does not claim to enumerate every private, newly announced, or unlisted event.
catalog.geography: City and County of San Francisco only
catalog.row_standard: Every published row carries an organizer, venue, or government source link. Dates, hours, locations, and admissions are shown only when stated in the linked source captured for this audit.
catalog.field_policy: An em dash means the linked source did not state that optional field in the captured record. Rows needing a decision, scope correction, or an essential missing value are separated on the Flagged for Review page.
catalog.sources_policy: Official organizer, official venue, or government sources; a small number of municipal arts-calendar records are labeled as trusted civic sources.

events.name: Fillmore Jazz Festival
events.location: Fillmore Street (12 blocks from Jackson to Eddy Streets), Fillmore District, San Francisco
events.organizer: Fillmore Jazz Festival Preservation Fund & Fillmore Merchants Association
events.notes: Irregularity: the previously cited domain fillmorejazzfestival.com is dead/hijacked as of 2026-10-18 (serves a parked spam site, Cloudflare 522) — do not use. Row rolled forward to the 2027 edition ("Saturday & Sunday, July 3 & 4, 2027") announced on the live official site, the organizers’ 40th anniversary year. The 2026 edition ran July 4–5, 2026, 10am–6pm, on Fillmore Street between Jackson and Eddy per SFMTA advisory https://www.sfmta.com/project-updates/fillmore-jazz-festival-service-changes. 2027 hours not yet published → time blank.

events.name: Comedy Day
events.location: Robin Williams Meadow (formerly Sharon Meadow), Golden Gate Park, San Francisco
events.organizer: Comedy Day / San Francisco Recreation and Park Department
events.notes: Date corrected 2026-10-18: the previously recorded September 13 was actually the Opera in the Park date. Organizer site (comedyday.org) confirms "Comedy Day 2026" at Robin Williams Meadow, free admission, and the 11:45am–5:00pm schedule, but does not print the calendar date in page text; the date is confirmed by SF Rec & Park’s Tentative Calendars of Special Events (https://sfrecpark.org/1310/Tentative-Calendars-of-Special-Events): "September 20 Comedy Day at Robin Williams Meadow". Rec & Park also notes Comedy Day has run every September since 1981 (sfrecpark.org/1178).
